name: dsh-desktop
description: 让 Agent 安全常驻桌面的独立 DeepSeek Harness 客户端：官方 Web UI 原封不动，长任务常驻后台，精选插件先审查再安装 / Independent desktop client that keeps dsh agents resident and secure: the official Web UI untouched, long tasks alive in the tray, curated plugins reviewed before install
author: bruc3van

scripts.build:shell: esbuild src/main/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:electron --outfile=.build/main.mjs && esbuild src/main/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=.build/preload.cjs && esbuild src/main/runtime-launcher.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:electron --outfile=.build/runtime-launcher.mjs && esbuild src/main/dsh-cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:electron --outfile=.build/dsh-cli.mjs
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run prepare:runtime && npm run check:picker && npm run check:runtime-env && npm run check:runtime-spawn && npm run check:dsh-cli && npm run check:smart-runtimes && npm run check:bundled-plugin && npm run check:runtime-lock && npm run check:restart && npm run check:pnpm-engine && npm run check:nsis-details && electron-builder --dir && npm run check:pnpm-runtime
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run prepare:runtime && npm run check:picker && npm run check:runtime-env && npm run check:runtime-spawn && npm run check:dsh-cli && npm run check:smart-runtimes && npm run check:bundled-plugin && npm run check:runtime-lock && npm run check:restart && npm run check:pnpm-engine && npm run check:nsis-details && electron-builder --publish never && npm run check:pnpm-runtime
